subject: Align de-identification boundary with shared contract
description: Correct process_vlm integration to match the agreed teammate contract: de-identification receives tuple[ExtractedKeyframe, ...] before conversion to VlmFramePayload and returns an outcome exposing transformed frames plus per-frame reports. Validate exactly eight reports, preserved ordering/timestamps/frame indexes, valid JPEG/hash via validate_keyframes, and PASS status/count consistency. Do not require every JPEG byte sequence to change because a frame with zero people may legitimately remain unchanged; rely on the report contract and fail closed. Keep the teammate implementation absent/injected and do not add a no-op. Update focused tests and rerun python -m pytest tests/test_vlm*.py -q.
